title: Explicit household selection changes SIPP material-pressure diagnostics
source_unit: 2025 SIPP person records by household-month, compared with one deterministic reference-person selection per household-month

denominator.unit: selected household-month records from 379,215 person-record/month rows; ERP=1 preferred, then lowest PNUM

unable_to_pay_rent_or_mortgage.unit: percent; pseudo Fay-BRR SE 0.213 percentage points; approximate 95% interval 4.071–4.907

unable_to_pay_utility_bills.unit: percent; pseudo Fay-BRR SE 0.246 percentage points; approximate 95% interval 5.976–6.941

high_or_marginal_food_security.unit: percent; pseudo Fay-BRR SE 0.349 percentage points; approximate 95% interval 87.541–88.909

observations.method: One record per SSUID/SHHADID/SPANEL/SWAVE/MONTHCODE was selected by preferring ERP=1 and using the lowest PNUM as a deterministic fallback. The selected record retained WPFINWGT and matched to REPWGT1–240 by SSUID/PNUM/SPANEL/SWAVE/MONTHCODE; Fay BRR used G=240 and perturbation factor 0.5.
observations.uncertainty: The replicate intervals are sensitivity diagnostics because the extracted surface supplies a final person weight, not an official household weight. They do not establish official household prevalence.
observations.subgroup: Reference-person-selected household-month context; household fields are evaluated once per selected household-month.
observations.counterinterpretation: Selection reduces the utility-payment share by 0.605 percentage points, rent/mortgage difficulty by 0.148 points, and high/marginal food security by 0.338 points relative to the person-record view, but these differences may reflect the person-weight and selection rule rather than a substantive household pattern.

denominator.unit: positive-final-person-weight person-record/month rows; field-specific status flags retained

unable_to_pay_rent_or_mortgage.unit: percent; point estimate from WPFINWGT person-record view

unable_to_pay_utility_bills.unit: percent; point estimate from WPFINWGT person-record view

high_or_marginal_food_security.unit: percent; point estimate from WPFINWGT person-record view

observations.method: All positive-final-weight person records were retained with field-specific nonblank and official status-flag rules. This is the comparison surface, not a household estimate.
observations.uncertainty: No replicate variance was computed for this comparison view in the selection diagnostic; the point estimates are retained only to show sensitivity to unit construction.
observations.subgroup: Person record by reference month, with household fields repeated on person records.
observations.counterinterpretation: The person-record view can overweight larger households when a repeated household field is interpreted as a household condition; the selected view avoids repeated rows but does not solve the absent household-weight problem.

related_sources.claim: Official field labels, universe, and status-flag documentation.
Official 240-replicate-weight archive used for the selected-record sensitivity diagnostic.

weight_surface_audit.interpretation: The current 2025 public-use schema surface exposes the final person weight but no separately named household weight. The one-record-per-household-month results therefore remain sensitivity diagnostics, not official household prevalence estimates.

boundary: This record makes household selection explicit but does not create an official household-weighted estimate. It establishes selection sensitivity in a 2024-reference-year SIPP diagnostic, not a trend, causal price or bill effect, time displacement, recovery, trust change, or political action.
